{
"schema_version": "structured_v1_icaira",
"criterion_comparisons": [
{"pair_id":"C1_C2","criterion_a":"C1","criterion_b":"C2","preferred":"C2","intensity":"moderate","reason":"Benefit side carries the business case; cost is known and controllable, released hours drive the return."},
{"pair_id":"C3_C5","criterion_a":"C3","criterion_b":"C5","preferred":"C3","intensity":"moderate","reason":"Integration effort is cash and scarce change bandwidth; throughput headroom matters less at our user scale."},
{"pair_id":"C2_C4","criterion_a":"C2","criterion_b":"C4","preferred":"C4","intensity":"moderate","reason":"Probability-weighted compliance loss threatens audit standing and earnings; benefits are estimates until realized."},
{"pair_id":"C1_C6","criterion_a":"C1","criterion_b":"C6","preferred":"C1","intensity":"strong","reason":"Annual TCO is the funded, contracted commitment; onboarding hours are a one-time absorbable cost."},
{"pair_id":"C4_C5","criterion_a":"C4","criterion_b":"C5","preferred":"C4","intensity":"strong","reason":"Quantified exposure hits reported results and control environment; throughput is a technical capacity detail."},
{"pair_id":"C2_C3","criterion_a":"C2","criterion_b":"C3","preferred":"C2","intensity":"moderate","reason":"Recurring benefit outweighs a one-off implementation effort over the multi-year planning cycle."},
{"pair_id":"C1_C4","criterion_a":"C1","criterion_b":"C4","preferred":"C1","intensity":"moderate","reason":"Contracted annual spend is certain cash outflow; exposure loss is probability weighted and mitigable."},
{"pair_id":"C5_C6","criterion_a":"C5","criterion_b":"C6","preferred":"C6","intensity":"moderate","reason":"Onboarding time delays benefit realization across all users; throughput exceeds expected demand either way."},
{"pair_id":"C3_C4","criterion_a":"C3","criterion_b":"C4","preferred":"C4","intensity":"moderate","reason":"Recurring compliance loss recurs annually; integration effort is bounded, staged and one-time."},
{"pair_id":"C2_C6","criterion_a":"C2","criterion_b":"C6","preferred":"C2","intensity":"strong","reason":"Released hours are the payback engine; training time only shifts the start date."},
{"pair_id":"C1_C5","criterion_a":"C1","criterion_b":"C5","preferred":"C1","intensity":"very_strong","reason":"Annual cost drives funding and payback; throughput is adequate across all candidates."},
{"pair_id":"C4_C6","criterion_a":"C4","criterion_b":"C6","preferred":"C4","intensity":"strong","reason":"Compliance loss is a recurring financial and audit risk; onboarding is a manageable one-time load."},
{"pair_id":"C2_C5","criterion_a":"C2","criterion_b":"C5","preferred":"C2","intensity":"very_strong","reason":"Productivity hours convert into measurable value; raw throughput does not appear in the business case."},
{"pair_id":"C1_C3","criterion_a":"C1","criterion_b":"C3","preferred":"C1","intensity":"moderate","reason":"Recurring annual TCO dominates lifetime cost versus a single integration effort."},
{"pair_id":"C3_C6","criterion_a":"C3","criterion_b":"C6","preferred":"C3","intensity":"moderate","reason":"Engineering days consume scarce capital and delivery capacity; user training scales more easily."}
],
"declared_priority_order": ["C2","C1","C4"]
}
